patch.value: The release Sentry gate counts environment=test issues, so a downstream extension's CI test run blocks the daily pm-cli release

The 2026-11-04 Auto Release dispatcher run 41769022809 failed at sentry-telemetry-gate on PM-CLI-3R, 3S, 3T, 3V, 3W and 3X: ExtensionCommandError from the global pm-vcs extension (vcs fetch/push/clone/remote, pm.error_code=denied, exit 1, ObjectStoreError 'The requested repository is not available'). Every event carries environment=test and pm.source_context=test (env_override) and came from GitHub runners: pm-vcs's test/served-defects.test.ts spawns an installed pm with PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=test, which pm-cli's documented policy treats as permission for intentional test delivery, so the expected refusals reached production Sentry. buildSentryGateQuery in scripts/release/sentry-telemetry-gate.mjs queries 'is:unresolved level:[fatal,error] lastSeen:-Nd' with no environment filter, so test-labeled events block the cut although pm-9aaji6 already routes test children to the test environment so they stay out of production diagnostics. Same failure family as the 2026-10-30 cross-repo block (pm-gh1622).

The release Sentry gate excludes issues whose events are environment=test (or pm.source_context=test), with a spec and a negative control showing a production-environment error still blocks; pm-vcs's served-defects test stops delivering to production Sentry (PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED or a local collector), tracked and fixed in the pm-vcs repo; docs/CONFIGURATION.md states that PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=test opts into delivery and that tests which only want the label must also disable telemetry
Test-labeled telemetry from any repository never blocks the pm-cli daily release
Six environment=test issues from pm-vcs CI blocked the 2026-11-04 dispatcher cut

message: File release Sentry gate test-environment block

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Live Sentry API check (2026-11-04): appending !environment:test to the gate query excludes exactly the issues whose every event is test. Over a 60-day window, 17 issues became 11: the six pm-vcs issues (test only) dropped out, while PM-CLI-3H (ci=144, production=44, test=8) and the production-only issues were kept. So the negation filters test-only issues, not mixed ones. Fix direction: buildSentryGateQuery appends !environment:test, and the specs assert the query.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Progress on branch fix/test-telemetry-delivery: criteria 1 and 3 are delivered. buildSentryGateQuery now appends !environment:test, which applies to both the API path and the sentry CLI fallback. Sentry drops an issue only when every event is environment=test, and a live check against the project showed 17 issues becoming 11 with the mixed-environment PM-CLI-3H kept. A negative-control spec in sentry-telemetry-gate.spec.ts models that search and shows production and mixed issues still blocking. docs/RELEASING.md documents the exclusion. docs/CONFIGURATION.md states that PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=test opts into delivery, so a test that only wants the label must also set PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1, and it now names PM_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT for local collectors. Criterion 2, that pm-vcs's served-defects test stops delivering, is owned by the pm-vcs repo: unbraind/pm-vcs#176 is fixed by unbraind/pm-vcs#179, which is open with green checks while its rebase is deferred by the fleet session. This item stays open until that PR merges.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: PR 1661, CodeRabbit round on a8fb282a0 (Major), fixed. The test-environment exclusion had been folded into the activity query as 'is:unresolved level:[fatal,error] !environment:test lastSeen:-Nd'. Sentry applies lastSeen after the environment filter, so an issue whose production event predates the window while a test event falls inside it was dropped. This AC excludes only issues whose events are all environment=test, so such a mixed issue must keep blocking as it did before. buildSentryGateQuery is back to the pre-PR activity query (any environment). fetchSentryGateIssues runs a second, unenriched listing 'is:unresolved level:[fatal,error] !environment:test' with no window, and excludeTestOnlyIssues drops an active issue only when that listing is complete and lacks its shortId. A listing that may be truncated (a next page reported by the Link header, or a result count at the limit) drops nothing, and a failed listing fails the fetch with sentry_environment_query_failed. The gate receipt now reports ignored_test_only_total, ignored_test_only_short_ids and environment_listing_complete. Specs model Sentry's filter order: production, mixed and mixed-with-stale-production issues block, a test-only issue is ignored, a stale production-only issue falls outside the window, and both truncation signals and the listing failure are covered. Live check on 2026-11-05: 6 unresolved issues active within 14 days, 0 unresolved issues with any non-test event and no next page, so the same six test-only issues stay excluded. docs/RELEASING.md describes the two queries.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: PR 1661, CodeRabbit round on 209e7234b (Major), fixed. The gate read only the first page of the active listing, and Sentry caps a page at 100 issues. A first page holding only test-only issues therefore let the gate pass without reading a production issue on a later page, which excluding test-only issues had made reachable. fetchSentryIssuePages now follows the Link header's next page while it holds results, up to --sentry-limit (default 200), for both the active and the non-test listing. fetchSentryGateIssues records active_listing_complete, and isSentryThresholdOk fails the Sentry side when active issues remain beyond the limit, because the gate cannot judge issues it never read. Specs cover a production issue on page 2 behind a page of test-only issues, which now blocks; an active listing cut off at the limit holding only test-only issues, which now fails; and the non-test listing truncated either by a next page past the limit or by a full last page. docs/RELEASING.md states the pagination and the fail-closed limit.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Telemetry counterpart, measured 2026-11-07 over 7 days of command_finish events: source_context=test fails 20.08% (8470/42175, deliberate negative controls, conflict and lock races), automation 3.67% (7103/193553), user 0% (0/9). The blended 6.61% tripped the local 'sentry-telemetry-gate.mjs --telemetry-mode required' ceiling of 6% although automation was healthy. The release workflow runs that gate with '--telemetry-mode off', so no cut was blocked. The local, gitignored telemetry query (scripts/prod/telemetry/query-telemetry.sh) now computes the overall finish error rate with source_context=test excluded, matching the Sentry half's test-only exclusion, and reports a per-source_context breakdown so the test rate stays visible. The gate then passed (critical=0, high=0). The same rule applies to the Sentry side this item tracks: test-context signals are reported, never counted against release health.
